approach: A hole in a sheet expands exactly like the metal that would fill it, so its diameter grows by the same fraction as any length.

steps.text: Apply linear expansion to the diameter, treating the hole as if it were a disc of the same metal.
steps.why_this_step: Every length in the sheet, including the edge of the empty circle, scales by the same factor.

common_mistakes.text: Expecting the hole to shrink because the metal around it expands inward. Every length scales up, so the hole grows.
Using 2αΔT, the area coefficient, on a diameter gives 5.04 cm.
